title: "The Church Should Be a Hospital for Sinners—Not a Club for Hypocrites!" 🔥
paragraphs: "The Church Should Be a Hospital for Sinners—Not a Club for Hypocrites!" 🔥

🔥 WHY ARE SO MANY PEOPLE LEAVING THE CHURCH?
🚪 They come seeking healing, but they find rejection.
😨 They come needing grace, but they find judgment.
💔 They come looking for Jesus, but they find hypocrisy.
📖 "I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance." (Luke 5:32)
🚨 THE CHURCH WAS MEANT TO HEAL THE BROKEN—NOT CONDEMN THEM!

🔥 1. JESUS WELCOMED SINNERS—SO WHY DON’T WE?
📖 "Come to Me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." (Matthew 11:28)
🚨 WHO DID JESUS REACH OUT TO?

✅ The tax collectors and prostitutes (Matthew 21:31)
✅ The outcasts and rejected (Luke 19:10)
✅ The broken and hurting (Mark 2:17)
🔥 If Jesus ran the modern church, He would be sitting with the very people we ignore.
📖 "The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost." (Luke 19:10)
🚨 THE CHURCH SHOULD LOOK MORE LIKE JESUS—NOT A COUNTRY CLUB FOR THE "HOLY."

🔥 2. HYPOCRISY IS DRIVING PEOPLE AWAY FROM GOD
📖 "You shut the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. You do not enter yourselves, nor allow others to enter." (Matthew 23:13)
🚨 SIGNS OF A CHURCH THAT HAS BECOME A "CLUB":

❌ They focus on IMAGE, not TRANSFORMATION.
❌ They judge outsiders but hide their own sin.
❌ They reject people who don’t "fit in."
❌ They preach prosperity, but not repentance.
🔥 NO WONDER SO MANY PEOPLE ARE LEAVING!
📖 "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me." (Matthew 15:8)
🚨 ARE WE DRAWING PEOPLE TO JESUS—OR PUSHING THEM AWAY?

🔥 3. HOW TO MAKE THE CHURCH A PLACE OF HEALING AGAIN
📖 "Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ." (Galatians 6:2)
🚀 HERE’S HOW WE CAN BRING JESUS BACK INTO HIS CHURCH:

✅ 1. LOVE PEOPLE WHERE THEY ARE—BUT CALL THEM TO REPENTANCE.
📖 "Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more." (John 8:11)

✅ 2. STOP PLAYING CHURCH—START BEING THE CHURCH.
📖 "Let your light shine before others, so they may see your good works and give glory to God." (Matthew 5:16)

✅ 3. WELCOME THE BROKEN—NOT JUST THE "RELIGIOUS."
📖 "God shows no partiality." (Romans 2:11)

✅ 4. TEACH TRUTH—NOT JUST WHAT PEOPLE WANT TO HEAR.
📖 "Preach the word; be ready in season and out of season." (2 Timothy 4:2)
🔥 THE CHURCH IS A HOSPITAL FOR SINNERS—LET’S MAKE IT A PLACE WHERE PEOPLE FIND JESUS!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you believe the church should be a place of love and truth!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you commit to being a true follower of Jesus!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to spread this powerful message!

🔥 THE CHURCH REVIVAL CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine yourself—are you welcoming sinners like Jesus did?
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this powerful truth!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 24, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I don’t want to be part of a fake, lifeless church. Help me to love people like You do—to welcome the lost, to show grace, and to lead people to true repentance. Lord, remove every bit of hypocrisy from my life and fill me with Your Spirit. Let me be a light that draws people to Jesus, not religion. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
